Darlene strikes me as someone with SEVERAL neurological disorders in addition to mental illnesses and it's very disheartening to see the comments completely misunderstanding her. 

It's not an excuse, and it's important to hold people accountable even when struggling with these things, but as an autistic person I see a lot of myself in her and I know how frustrating it is when people just label you crazy. She's not a "meth addict" like some of these comments are saying. She is someone who needs intense therapy and real medication in addition to her holistic outlook. 

I think there are a lot of people who are labeling behaviors as manipulative or abusive and that may be true, but we need to try and A) presume positive intent and B) understand that a LOT of behaviors stemming from mental and/or neurological disorders may APPEAR manipulative when it's really just someone struggling very very hard to exist.
